name: install-paths
description: Install in one command — pnpm link and git main, proven

spec.why: Installation is the first touch. Today it takes a clone, a launcher symlink, and faith. Two paths must be true and documented: a dev link in one command (pnpm link) and a global install straight from the git main branch — both verified on the Node floor the docs claim.

requirements.text: EVERY workspace package points its entry at compiled dist: packages/cli bin → dist/src/main.js AND brand/core/web/knowledge main/exports → dist/src/index.js (tsc emits them); the whole chain runs on Node 22 and 24 — proven by running the dist bin under BOTH node binaries on this machine, not by a PATH that might hold an old launcher; bin/treadle.mjs retires (file AND the treadle/package.json bin field).

Dev link: from a fresh clone — pnpm install, pnpm build, pnpm link --global (from packages/cli, or one documented chain); the linked treadle passes --help + do where + a know command from an arbitrary directory.

Git install: the repo root IS the orchestrator — package.json named engram-dev (private, packageManager pinned, workspaces:["treadle"], bin → treadle/packages/cli/dist/src/main.js, prepare: corepack+install+build) AND the four @treadle/* siblings declared as file:treadle/packages/* dependencies so the global tree actually resolves them (workspaces alone ship nothing); npm i -g --allow-scripts=engram-dev github:phanijapps/engram-dev#main delivers a working treadle; the flag is documented as npm security default.
Clean-room verification: every documented path proves itself in a fresh temp clone on BOTH node floors (22.14, 24.19 present locally); a windows note records the CI-matrix check.
The pnpm git-workspace syntax is recorded broken (observed crash) unless a clean-room test passes in-wave; the guide names npm for git installs, pnpm for the dev link.
Guide section 03 + README rewritten to the two one-command paths; the launcher-symlink dance removed; install verified literally (AC-3).

Gates stay green UNCHANGED (check, corpus, brand, links) — stated truthfully: the brand fence and links gate walk treadle/ and markdown only, so the new repo-root package.json sits outside their scope by construction (like ci.yml); no allowance changes, no hole claimed as coverage.
The wave closes through its own loop: evidence rows, review rounds, frozen by human:owner.

clarifications.question: The git-install target: the whole repository (root package.json orchestrating treadle/ via prepare, npm --allow-scripts documented) or the future engram-dev shape where the workspace IS the repo root (cleanest, no orchestration layer)?
Node floor: the guide says 22+ — hold that floor (bin must point at compiled dist, proven working on 22.14) or raise the docs to 24 (native TS lets the source bin run)?

out_of_scope: registry publish (npm publish of one bundled package) — the successor that retires the whole question
the engram-dev code split (Q-1 names the shape; the bin and clean-room verifications carry over)

decisions.decision: bin → compiled dist everywhere; the Node floor is 22 (Q-2 answered in the room: hold 22+, bin to dist)
decisions.because: Proven by direct run: node 22.14 refuses the .ts bin. The earlier dist "proof" was withdrawn — it ran through a PATH holding the old launcher (the tenth instance, disclosed in R1); the wave re-proves with explicit binary invocation per package entry.

decisions.decision: The git install targets github.com/phanijapps/engram-dev#main; this repo root IS the orchestrator (Q-1 answered: the repo is linked to engram-dev)
decisions.because: Owner: the repo is already linked to engram-dev. Proven: npm skips prepare without --allow-scripts; the orchestrator must declare the bin; pnpm #workspace crashed. The placeholder docs commit was subsumed (206 files: 205 docs + README; the 10 product docs relocated to archive — none lost) and engram-dev main now carries the full history.

decisions.because: The guide teaches commands; every command must have run literally in a fresh clone on both node floors before it is printed.

verdicts.note: The artifact round reproduced my experiments and broke the two load-bearing proofs — the strongest catch this repo has had. (1) The dist-bin "proven on both floors" was a FALSE GREEN: my test ran through PATH, which held the old launcher→tsx symlink — the dist bin actually dies on BOTH nodes because every workspace sibling keeps main→src/index.ts (node 22: ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION at brand; node 24: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND at brand/src/brand.js — native stripping never rewrites .js→.ts, so even EXP A's "node 24 runs TS" premise was the launcher, not the language). The tenth instance of the class, disclosed. (2) The git-install sibling resolution was unproven and its stated mechanism wrong: workspaces are not dependencies and packs ship no node_modules — the root must declare the four @treadle/* as file: deps. All 12 findings folded: every package entry → dist (FR-1/T-0 widened, verify given teeth — no || true, explicit binaries, launcher field AND file both gone); the orchestrator named engram-dev with packageManager pinned, file: deps, root gitignore; clean-room scripts COMMITTED (scripts/cleanroom-{link,git}.sh) with transcript artifacts — the proofs falsifiable; D-1 accepted citing the room answer; FR-7 restated truthfully (the fences walk treadle/ only — the root file is out of scope by construction, not by allowance); counts corrected (206 files, 10 relocated, none lost); T-3 scoped to zero launcher mentions anywhere in the guide.
